item.title: 2026-06-10 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning and welcome to our daily news talk. I am Aria.
(早上好，欢迎收听我们的每日新闻谈话。我是 Aria。)
[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very big day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有很多重大的新闻要带给大家。)
[Aria] We will look at the new Apple phone, the money market, and the hard news from the world.
(我们将关注苹果新款手机、金融市场以及来自世界各地的重大新闻。)
[Andrew] It is a busy time. Let us start with the new Apple phone news.
(现在非常忙碌。让我们从苹果手机的新闻开始吧。)
[Aria] Apple has a new phone coming. It is the iPhone 17. But there is a problem.
(苹果有一款新手机即将推出。那就是 iPhone 17。但有一个问题。)
[Andrew] Yes, the memory limit is the issue. It only has eight gigabytes.
(是的，内存限制是个问题。它只有 8GB。)
[Aria] Because of this, it cannot use some new smart computer programs.
(正因如此，它无法使用一些新的智能计算机程序。)
[Andrew] These programs are part of the new system. It is a shame for the users.
(这些程序是新系统的一部分。这对用户来说很可惜。)
[Aria] The system is called iOS 27. It needs more power to work well.
(这个系统叫 iOS 27。它需要更多的动力才能良好运行。)
[Andrew] Apple is trying to make its smart system better. They call it Siri.
(苹果正试图改进其智能系统。他们称之为 Siri。)
[Aria] But if the phone does not have enough memory, the smart system will be slow.
(但如果手机内存不足，智能系统就会变慢。)
[Andrew] This is a big change in the market. People want the best tools.
(这是市场上的一个重大变化。人们想要最好的工具。)
[Aria] Also, there is a new design change for the computer system. It is called Liquid Glass.
(此外，计算机系统还有一个新的设计变化。它被称为液体玻璃。)
[Andrew] People did not like the old look. Now Apple is making it better.
(人们不喜欢旧的外观。现在苹果正在改进它。)
[Aria] They are changing the way the screen looks. It will be more clear.
(他们正在改变屏幕的外观。它会更清晰。)
[Andrew] This is good news for people who use Apple computers for work.
(这对使用苹果电脑工作的人来说是个好消息。)
[Aria] Let us move to cameras. Insta360 has a new camera.
(让我们转到相机。Insta360 有一款新相机。)
[Andrew] It is called the Luna Ultra. It is very small and strong.
(它叫 Luna Ultra。它非常小巧且强大。)
[Aria] It is made to compete with the DJI camera.
(它是为了与大疆相机竞争而制造的。)
[Andrew] The video quality is very high. It is eight K quality.
(视频质量非常高。是 8K 质量。)
[Aria] That is very clear. Many people who make videos will want this.
(那非常清晰。许多制作视频的人会想要这个。)
[Andrew] It also has a special tool to keep the picture steady.
(它还有一个特殊的工具来保持画面稳定。)
[Aria] That is important for walking and filming at the same time.
(这对边走边拍很重要。)
[Andrew] Now, let us talk about money. The news is not very good.
(现在，让我们谈谈钱。消息不太好。)
[Aria] Inflation is going up in the United States. This is the biggest jump in three years.
(美国的通货膨胀正在上升。这是三年来的最大涨幅。)
[Andrew] This means things are getting more expensive for everyone.
(这意味着对每个人来说，东西都变得更贵了。)
[Aria] Food, gas, and other things cost more money now.
(食物、汽油和其他东西现在花费更多钱。)
[Andrew] The government is worried. They want to stop this from getting worse.
(政府很担心。他们想阻止这种情况恶化。)
[Aria] The stock market is also feeling the pain. The Dow is down.
(股市也感受到了痛苦。道琼斯指数下跌了。)
[Andrew] Investors are selling their stocks because they are afraid.
(投资者因为害怕而卖出他们的股票。)
[Aria] They do not know if the economy will be safe.
(他们不知道经济是否会安全。)
[Andrew] There is also news about SpaceX. People want to buy their stock.
(还有关于 SpaceX 的新闻。人们想买他们的股票。)
[Aria] But the company has not started selling stock yet.
(但该公司还没有开始出售股票。)
[Andrew] People are waiting for the IPO. That is when a company first sells stock.
(人们在等待首次公开募股。那是公司第一次出售股票的时候。)
[Aria] The demand is very high. It is four times more than expected.
(需求非常高。是预期的四倍。)
[Andrew] That shows how much people believe in the future of space travel.
(这显示了人们对太空旅行未来的信心。)
[Aria] Let us talk about energy. GM is doing something new.
(让我们谈谈能源。通用汽车正在做一些新的事情。)
[Andrew] They are making new batteries for energy storage.
(他们正在制造用于储能的新电池。)
[Aria] This will help keep power for when it is needed.
(这将有助于在需要时保持电力。)
[Andrew] They are also letting people sell power back to the grid.
(他们还允许人们将电力卖回电网。)
[Aria] That is a smart way to use electric cars.
(这是使用电动汽车的一种聪明方式。)
[Andrew] Now, let us look at China. There is news about their car market.
(现在，让我们看看中国。有关于他们汽车市场的新闻。)
[Aria] The demand for cars inside China is under pressure.
(中国国内对汽车的需求正面临压力。)
[Andrew] But they are selling many cars to other countries.
(但他们正在向其他国家销售许多汽车。)
[Aria] This helps keep their car companies strong.
(这有助于保持他们汽车公司的强大。)
[Aria] China is also spending a lot of money on data centers.
(中国也在数据中心上投入大量资金。)
[Aria] They want to be the best in artificial intelligence.
(他们想在人工智能方面做到最好。)
[Andrew] That is a very big plan. It will cost almost three hundred billion dollars.
(那是一个非常大的计划。它将花费近三千亿美元。)
[Aria] That is a lot of money for technology.
(这对技术来说是一大笔钱。)
[Andrew] Now, let us talk about the world and conflicts.
(现在，让我们谈谈世界和冲突。)
[Aria] There is tension between the United States and Iran.
(美国和伊朗之间存在紧张局势。)
[Andrew] Donald Trump said Iran will pay the price.
(唐纳德·特朗普说伊朗将付出代价。)
[Aria] This is because Iran targeted American assets.
(这是因为伊朗针对了美国的资产。)
[Andrew] The situation is very serious. People are watching it closely.
(局势非常严重。人们正在密切关注。)
[Aria] Also, there is trouble in Belfast.
(此外，贝尔法斯特也出现了麻烦。)
[Andrew] There were violent protests after a knife attack.
(在一次持刀袭击后发生了暴力抗议。)
[Aria] People are angry about immigration. It is a difficult time.
(人们对移民感到愤怒。这是一个困难的时期。)
[Andrew] We also have a strange story from Canada.
(我们还有一个来自加拿大的奇怪故事。)
[Aria] An Air Canada pilot flew for years with a fake license.
(一名加拿大航空公司的飞行员用假执照飞行了多年。)
[Andrew] That is very dangerous. How did no one know?
(那非常危险。怎么会没有人知道呢？)
[Aria] It is a mystery. The police are looking into it now.
(这是一个谜。警察现在正在调查。)
[Andrew] Finally, let us talk about China and North Korea.
(最后，让我们谈谈中国和朝鲜。)
[Aria] They are making their ties stronger again.
(他们正在再次加强他们的联系。)
[Andrew] This is important for the balance of power in the area.
(这对该地区的权力平衡很重要。)
[Aria] It is a complex world we live in.
(我们生活在一个复杂的世界里。)
[Andrew] Yes, it is. We have covered a lot today.
(是的，确实如此。我们今天谈了很多。)
[Aria] We talked about Apple, money, cars, and world news.
(我们谈到了苹果、金钱、汽车和世界新闻。)
[Andrew] We hope this helps you learn more English.
(我们希望这能帮助你学习更多的英语。)
[Aria] Thank you for listening to our podcast.
(感谢收听我们的播客。)
[Andrew] See you tomorrow for more news.
(明天见，会有更多新闻。)
[Aria] Have a good day and keep learning.
(祝你有美好的一天，继续学习。)
[Andrew] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)

item.title: 2026-06-10 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning everyone! Welcome to our morning news podcast. I am Aria.
(大家早上好！欢迎收听我们的早间新闻播客。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very busy day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有很多重要新闻要告诉大家。)

[Aria] We will start with the world of technology. Apple has a new problem. The iPhone 17 has a limit of 8GB of memory. Because of this, it cannot use two new AI features in the new system.
(我们先从科技界开始。苹果公司遇到了一个新问题。iPhone 17 的内存限制为 8GB。因此，它无法使用新系统中的两项人工智能功能。)

[Andrew] That is a big deal, Aria. Apple is trying to be a leader in the AI race. But if the hardware is not strong enough, the software cannot work well. This shows that even a great company has limits.
(这很重要，Aria。苹果正试图成为人工智能竞赛的领导者。但如果硬件不够强大，软件就无法良好运行。这表明即使是一家伟大的公司也有局限性。)

[Aria] It is true. History shows that Apple likes to keep things simple. But AI needs a lot of power. The new AI models from Apple are very complex. They need a lot of memory to work.
(确实如此。历史表明苹果喜欢保持简单。但人工智能需要强大的能力。苹果的新人工智能模型非常复杂。它们需要大量内存才能工作。)

[Andrew] And we also see news about the Honor Magic V6. It is a folding phone. People call it a mechanical wonder. It is very different from the normal phones we see every day.
(我们还看到了关于荣耀 Magic V6 的新闻。这是一款折叠手机。人们称它为机械奇迹。它与我们每天看到的普通手机非常不同。)

[Aria] I like the idea of a folding phone. It gives you a big screen in a small body. But is it strong enough? That is the question many people ask.
(我喜欢折叠手机的想法。它让你在小巧的机身中拥有大屏幕。但它足够坚固吗？这是许多人提出的问题。)

[Andrew] The company says it will have seven years of support. That is a long time for a phone. It shows they believe in the quality of their work.
(该公司表示将提供七年的支持。对于手机来说，这很长。这表明他们对自己的产品质量充满信心。)

[Aria] Let us move to business. The news is not very good. US inflation is now at 4.2 percent. This is because of the energy shock in the Middle East.
(让我们转向商业新闻。消息不太好。美国通货膨胀率现在为 4.2%。这是因为中东的能源冲击。)

[Andrew] Inflation is a hard word for many families. It means the price of food and gas goes up. When prices go up, people have less money to spend on other things.
(对于许多家庭来说，通货膨胀是一个沉重的词。这意味着食品和汽油的价格上涨。当价格上涨时，人们花在其他事情上的钱就变少了。)

[Aria] And the stock market is feeling the pain. The Dow dropped 650 points. This happened because of the news about inflation and the tension with Iran.
(股市也感受到了痛苦。道琼斯指数下跌了 650 点。这是因为通货膨胀的消息以及与伊朗的紧张关系。)

[Andrew] Trump said that Iran will pay the price. This kind of talk makes the market nervous. Investors do not like uncertainty. They want to know that the world is safe.
(特朗普表示伊朗将付出代价。这种言论让市场感到紧张。投资者不喜欢不确定性。他们希望世界是安全的。)

[Aria] Speaking of money, many people want to buy stock in SpaceX. But it is not easy. The price is very high. It is a big risk for a normal person.
(说到钱，许多人想购买 SpaceX 的股票。但这并不容易。价格非常高。对于普通人来说，这是一个巨大的风险。)

[Andrew] SpaceX is doing great work with Starlink. It is a real business that makes money. But buying into a private company is very different from buying a normal stock.
(SpaceX 在星链项目上做得很好。这是一项真正赚钱的业务。但投资一家私人公司与购买普通股票非常不同。)

[Aria] Let us talk about AI again. Anthropic has a new model called Claude Fable 5. It is very powerful. But some people are worried about the security.
(让我们再谈谈人工智能。Anthropic 有一个名为 Claude Fable 5 的新模型。它非常强大。但有些人担心它的安全性。)

[Andrew] Security is the most important thing for AI. If the model is too smart, it might do things we do not want. We need to have guardrails.
(安全性是人工智能最重要的事。如果模型太聪明，它可能会做我们不想要的事情。我们需要设置护栏。)

[Aria] That is a good point. We want the benefits of AI, but we must be safe. It is a balance between progress and danger.
(说得好。我们想要人工智能带来的好处，但我们必须安全。这是进步与危险之间的平衡。)

[Andrew] Now, let us look at China. The car market is under pressure. People are not buying as many cars as before.
(现在，让我们看看中国。汽车市场正面临压力。人们购买的汽车不如以前多了。)

[Aria] But the export of new energy vehicles is strong. This helps the companies stay in business. It is a change in the way they sell cars.
(但新能源汽车的出口很强劲。这有助于公司维持业务。这是他们销售汽车方式的一种改变。)

[Aria] Also, China has a big plan for AI data centers. They want to use their own chips. This is a very big investment.
(此外，中国在人工智能数据中心方面有一个宏大的计划。他们想使用自己的芯片。这是一项非常大的投资。)

[Andrew] Using local chips is a smart move. It makes them less dependent on other countries. But it is hard to make high-quality chips.
(使用本地芯片是明智之举。这使他们减少了对他国的依赖。但制造高质量的芯片很难。)

[Aria] We have to talk about the world news. There are protests in Belfast. It started after a stabbing attack. It is a very sad situation.
(我们必须谈谈世界新闻。贝尔法斯特发生了抗议活动。这是在一次刺伤袭击后开始的。这是一个非常悲伤的情况。)

[Andrew] Violence is never the answer. We hope the people there can find peace soon. It is a hard time for the city.
(暴力永远不是答案。我们希望那里的人们能尽快找到和平。这对城市来说是一个艰难的时期。)

[Aria] And we see China and North Korea working on their relationship. This changes the balance of power in the region.
(我们看到中国和朝鲜正在改善他们的关系。这改变了该地区的权力平衡。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is a complex situation. Every country wants to be in a strong position. Diplomacy is the best way to handle these things.
(是的，这是一个复杂的情况。每个国家都想处于有利地位。外交是处理这些事情的最好方式。)

[Aria] Finally, let us look at the fighter jet problem in Europe. Germany and France are having a hard time working together.
(最后，让我们看看欧洲的战斗机问题。德国和法国在合作方面遇到了困难。)

[Andrew] It is hard to build a plane together. Each country has its own ideas. They want to protect their own industry.
(一起制造飞机很难。每个国家都有自己的想法。他们想保护自己的工业。)

[Aria] But they need to work together to be strong. A united Europe is better for everyone.
(但他们需要合作才能强大。一个团结的欧洲对每个人都更好。)

[Andrew] That is all the time we have for today. It was a lot of news.
(这就是我们今天的所有时间了。新闻很多。)

[Aria] Thank you for listening. We will be back tomorrow with more news. Have a great day!
(感谢收听。我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。祝大家度过愉快的一天！)

[Andrew] Goodbye everyone!
(大家再见！)

[Aria] We should talk more about the iPhone 17. Why is 8GB not enough? Because the new AI features need to keep a lot of data in the memory. If the memory is full, the phone becomes slow.
(我们应该多谈谈 iPhone 17。为什么 8GB 不够？因为新的人工智能功能需要在内存中保留大量数据。如果内存满了，手机就会变慢。)

[Andrew] That makes sense. It is like a person trying to remember too many things at once. If you have a small brain, you get tired.
(这很有道理。就像一个人试图同时记住太多事情。如果你大脑容量小，你就会感到疲倦。)

[Aria] Exactly. And Apple is trying to make the phone do more things on the device itself. This is called private cloud compute. It is safer, but it needs more power.
(没错。苹果正试图让手机在设备本身上做更多事情。这被称为私有云计算。它更安全，但需要更多的能量。)

[Andrew] I think the Honor Magic V6 is interesting because of the screen. Folding screens are the future. But they are hard to make.
(我认为荣耀 Magic V6 因为屏幕而很有趣。折叠屏是未来。但它们很难制造。)

[Aria] Yes, the mechanical parts must be perfect. If they break, the phone is useless. That is why the seven-year update is so important. It gives the user peace of mind.
(是的，机械部件必须完美。如果它们坏了，手机就没用了。这就是为什么七年更新如此重要。它让用户感到安心。)

[Andrew] Let us go back to the inflation news. 4.2 percent is a high number. The central bank will probably keep interest rates high. This makes it hard for people to buy houses.
(让我们回到通货膨胀的新闻。4.2% 是一个很高的数字。中央银行可能会保持高利率。这使得人们很难买房。)

[Aria] That is a very important point. High interest rates are a tool to stop inflation. But they hurt the common person. It is a difficult choice for the government.
(这是一个非常重要的点。高利率是阻止通货膨胀的工具。但它们伤害了普通人。这对政府来说是一个艰难的选择。)

[Andrew] And the Middle East energy shock. Oil is the life of the world economy. If the price of oil goes up, everything else goes up.
(还有中东的能源冲击。石油是世界经济的生命线。如果石油价格上涨，其他一切都会上涨。)

[Aria] It is a chain reaction. The cost of transport goes up. The cost of food goes up. The cost of electricity goes up.
(这是一种连锁反应。运输成本上涨。食品成本上涨。电力成本上涨。)

[Andrew] We see this in the stock market too. Companies that use a lot of energy are losing money. Their profit margins are getting smaller.
(我们在股市中也看到了这一点。消耗大量能源的公司正在亏损。他们的利润率正在变小。)

[Aria] What about SpaceX? Why is the IPO so shocking? Because people think it will be a great company in the future. Everyone wants a piece of it.
(SpaceX 怎么样？为什么首次公开募股如此令人震惊？因为人们认为它在未来会是一家伟大的公司。每个人都想分一杯羹。)

[Andrew] But the price is based on hope, not just current profit. That is why it is risky. You are buying the future, not the past.
(但价格是基于希望，而不仅仅是当前的利润。这就是为什么它有风险。你买的是未来，而不是过去。)

[Aria] Let us talk about Claude Fable 5 again. Anthropic is a company that cares about safety. They are different from other AI companies.
(让我们再谈谈 Claude Fable 5。Anthropic 是一家关心安全的公司。他们与其他人工智能公司不同。)

[Andrew] They want to make sure the AI does not harm people. This is a good goal. But it makes the model slower to release.
(他们想确保人工智能不会伤害人类。这是一个很好的目标。但它使模型的发布速度变慢了。)

[Aria] It is a trade-off. Do you want it fast, or do you want it safe? Most people want both.
(这是一个权衡。你想要它快，还是想要它安全？大多数人两者都想要。)

[Andrew] In China, the car market is changing. People want electric cars. But the competition is very high. Many companies are making cars.
(在中国，汽车市场正在发生变化。人们想要电动汽车。但竞争非常激烈。许多公司都在制造汽车。)

[Aria] That is why the domestic demand is under pressure. There are too many choices. And the economy is not growing as fast as before.
(这就是为什么国内需求面临压力。选择太多了。而且经济增长不如以前快了。)

[Andrew] But the exports are doing well. They are selling cars to other countries. This is a smart way to grow.
(但出口表现良好。他们正在向其他国家销售汽车。这是一种明智的增长方式。)

[Aria] And the AI data center plan. $295 billion is a lot of money. It shows how important AI is to the future of the country.
(还有人工智能数据中心计划。2950 亿美元是一笔巨款。这表明人工智能对国家的未来有多重要。)

[Andrew] They want to be independent. They do not want to rely on chips from other countries. This is a long-term plan.
(他们想独立。他们不想依赖其他国家的芯片。这是一个长期计划。)

[Aria] Let us look at the protests in Belfast again. It is a reminder that society is fragile. We need to listen to each other.
(让我们再看看贝尔法斯特的抗议活动。这提醒我们社会是脆弱的。我们需要倾听彼此。)

[Andrew] Yes, communication is key. When people feel they are not heard, they get angry. And anger leads to bad things.
(是的，沟通是关键。当人们觉得没有被倾听时，他们会生气。而愤怒会导致坏事。)

[Aria] And the North Korea and China relationship. It is a game of chess. Everyone is moving their pieces.
(还有朝鲜和中国的关系。这是一场国际象棋游戏。每个人都在移动他们的棋子。)

[Andrew] It is about influence. China wants to keep the region stable. North Korea wants to be a strong player.
(这关乎影响力。中国希望保持地区稳定。朝鲜希望成为一个强大的参与者。)

[Aria] Finally, the fighter jet. It is a symbol of European unity. If they cannot build a jet together, what does it mean for other things?

[Aria] We have covered a lot today. Technology, money, and world events. It is all connected.
(我们今天涵盖了很多内容。科技、金钱和世界大事。它们都是相互关联的。)

[Andrew] Everything we do affects everything else. That is the world we live in.

[Aria] Thank you for staying with us. We hope you learned something new today.

(再见！)

[Andrew] Goodbye!
(再见！)

item.title: 2026-06-11 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning and welcome to our daily news show for English learners.
(早上好，欢迎收听我们的每日英语学习新闻节目。)

(今天我们非常忙碌。我们将讨论新技术、金钱以及世界各地的消息。)
[Andrew] Yes, let us start with the news about Samsung and their phones.
(是的，让我们先从三星及其手机的新闻开始。)
[Aria] Samsung has a new update for the Galaxy S25. It now has two new features from the Galaxy S26.
(三星为 Galaxy S25 推出了新更新。它现在拥有了来自 Galaxy S26 的两项新功能。)
[Andrew] This is interesting. Why did they do this?
(这很有趣。他们为什么要这样做？)
[Aria] They want to make sure the phone is good for a long time. The update also fixes many small errors in the system.
(他们想确保手机能长期保持良好状态。这次更新还修复了系统中的许多小错误。)
[Andrew] I think this is good for the people who bought the phone. It makes the phone feel new again.
(我认为这对买手机的人来说是好事。这让手机感觉焕然一新。)
[Aria] Also, Samsung released a security update for the Galaxy Z Fold 7 and Flip 7.
(此外，三星还为 Galaxy Z Fold 7 和 Flip 7 发布了安全更新。)
[Andrew] Security is very important today. We have so much private information on our phones.
(安全在今天非常重要。我们的手机里有太多的私人信息。)
[Aria] That is true. If the phone is not safe, someone could take your information.
(确实如此。如果手机不安全，别人可能会窃取你的信息。)
[Andrew] Let us move to computers. Apple has a new version of their system called macOS 27.
(让我们转到电脑领域。苹果公司有一个名为 macOS 27 的新系统版本。)
[Aria] People are talking about the Golden Gate beta. It has many new things.
(人们正在谈论 Golden Gate 测试版。它有很多新东西。)
[Andrew] I like that it works better with wide screens. It makes work much easier.
(我喜欢它在宽屏上运行得更好的特点。这让工作变得容易多了。)
[Aria] But some people are waiting for the AI features. They have to wait in a line.
(但有些人正在等待人工智能功能。他们必须排队等待。)
[Andrew] That is a common thing now. Everyone wants the new AI tools.
(这在现在很常见。每个人都想要新的人工智能工具。)
[Aria] Speaking of AI, Deezer has a new tool to find AI music.
(说到人工智能，Deezer 有一个寻找人工智能音乐的新工具。)
[Andrew] Why do we need that? Is AI music bad?
(我们为什么需要那个？人工智能音乐很糟糕吗？)
[Aria] Some people think AI music takes money from real artists. This tool helps people see if a song is made by a machine.
(有些人认为人工智能音乐会从真正的艺术家那里夺走钱。这个工具可以帮助人们识别一首歌是否由机器制作。)
[Andrew] That is a smart idea. It protects the work of real people.
(这是一个聪明的想法。它保护了真正的人类工作。)
[Aria] Also, there is news about a phone that looks like it was made by Donald Trump.
(此外，还有关于一部看起来像是唐纳德·特朗普制造的手机的新闻。)
[Andrew] iFixit looked inside the phone. They found it is just an old HTC phone with a new name.
(iFixit 查看了手机内部。他们发现它只是一部换了新名字的旧 HTC 手机。)
[Aria] That is funny. It shows that sometimes things are not what they look like.
(这很有趣。这表明有时事物并非它们看起来的那样。)
[Andrew] Let us talk about money. SpaceX is going to sell parts of the company to the public.
(让我们谈谈钱。SpaceX 将向公众出售公司股份。)
[Aria] People want to buy it. They have put in 70 billion dollars in orders.
(人们想买它。他们已经投入了 700 亿美元的订单。)
[Andrew] That is a very large amount of money. It shows people believe in the future of space travel.
(那是一笔非常大的钱。这表明人们相信太空旅行的未来。)
[Aria] Many people who work at SpaceX will become very rich. They might buy big houses or fast planes.
(许多在 SpaceX 工作的人将变得非常富有。他们可能会买大房子或快飞机。)
[Andrew] It is a big change for them. I hope they use the money well.
(这对他们来说是一个巨大的改变。我希望他们能善用这些钱。)
[Aria] In Europe, the bank has raised interest rates. This is because the war in Iran is making energy very expensive.
(在欧洲，银行提高了利率。这是因为伊朗的战争使能源变得非常昂贵。)
[Andrew] When energy is expensive, everything becomes expensive. This is hard for the normal person.
(当能源昂贵时，一切都会变得昂贵。这对普通人来说很困难。)
[Aria] Yes, the government has to try to keep prices low, but it is not easy.
(是的，政府必须努力保持低价，但这并不容易。)
[Andrew] Let us look at China. China and Indonesia are working together on money and payments.
(让我们看看中国。中国和印度尼西亚正在金钱和支付方面进行合作。)
[Aria] This will make it easier for people to trade between the two countries.
(这将使两国之间的人们进行贸易变得更容易。)
[Andrew] Working together is always the best way to grow the economy.
(合作总是促进经济增长的最佳方式。)
[Aria] Now, let us talk about the news from the world. There is a lot of trouble in the Middle East.
(现在，让我们谈谈来自世界的新闻。中东有很多麻烦。)
[Andrew] Donald Trump said the US will hit Iran very hard. He also talked about Kharg Island.
(唐纳德·特朗普说美国将重击伊朗。他还谈到了哈尔克岛。)
[Aria] This is very serious. People are worried about what will happen next.
(这非常严重。人们担心接下来会发生什么。)
[Andrew] Also, some sailors from India died in the attacks. India is not happy about this.
(此外，一些来自印度的船员在袭击中丧生。印度对此很不高兴。)
[Aria] They want the attacks to stop. It is a very sad situation.
(他们希望袭击停止。这是一个非常悲伤的情况。)
[Aria] In the UK, the defense minister John Healey has left his job.
(在英国，国防大臣约翰·希利已经离职。)
[Andrew] Why did he leave? Was it because of the money for the army?
(他为什么要离开？是因为军队的钱吗？)
[Aria] Yes, he did not agree with the plan for spending. He thought the army needed more support.
(是的，他不同意支出计划。他认为军队需要更多的支持。)
[Andrew] It is hard to be a leader when you do not have enough money for your goals.
(当你没有足够的钱来实现目标时，很难成为一名领导者。)
[Aria] Also in the UK, there is trouble in Belfast. People are fighting in the streets.
(同样在英国，贝尔法斯特出现了麻烦。人们在街上打架。)
[Andrew] The police had to use water to stop them. It started after a bad attack.
(警察不得不用水来阻止他们。这一切始于一次严重的袭击之后。)
[Aria] It is important for people to stay calm. Fighting does not fix problems.
(人们保持冷静很重要。打架解决不了问题。)
[Andrew] Finally, let us talk about something interesting. Do you know where the word algorithm comes from?
(最后，让我们谈谈一些有趣的事情。你知道算法这个词是从哪里来的吗？)
[Aria] I think it comes from a person, right?
(我想它来自一个人，对吧？)
[Andrew] Yes, a person from Persia in the 9th century. He was a great math expert.
(是的，一个来自 9 世纪波斯的人。他是一位伟大的数学专家。)
[Aria] It is amazing how old ideas still help us today with our computers.
(古老的思想在今天仍然帮助我们使用电脑，这真是太神奇了。)
[Andrew] That is all the time we have for today. Thank you for listening.
(我们今天的时间就到这里。谢谢大家的收听。)
[Aria] We will be back tomorrow with more news. Have a great day!
(我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。祝大家有美好的一天！)
[Andrew] Goodbye everyone!
(再见大家！)
[Aria] Goodbye!
(再见！)
[Andrew] Let us talk more about the SpaceX news. It is very big for the market.
(让我们多谈谈 SpaceX 的新闻。这对市场来说非常大。)
[Aria] Yes, many people think this is the start of a new age for space.
(是的，许多人认为这是太空新时代的开始。)
[Andrew] I agree. If they can make space travel cheap, everyone can go.
(我同意。如果他们能让太空旅行变得便宜，每个人都可以去。)
[Aria] But we must be careful. Space is a dangerous place.
(但我们必须小心。太空是一个危险的地方。)
[Andrew] That is true. We need good rules for space.
(确实如此。我们需要为太空制定好的规则。)
[Aria] And what about the AI music detector? Do you think it will work?
(那么人工智能音乐检测器呢？你认为它会起作用吗？)
[Andrew] It is a good first step. But AI is getting very smart.
(这是一个好的第一步。但人工智能正变得非常聪明。)
[Aria] Maybe one day we will not know if a song is made by a human or a machine.
(也许有一天我们无法分辨一首歌是由人类还是机器制作的。)
[Andrew] That would be a strange world. I like the feeling of human art.
(那将是一个奇怪的世界。我喜欢人类艺术的感觉。)
[Aria] Me too. Art comes from the heart.
(我也是。艺术来自内心。)
[Andrew] Let us look at the news about the UK again. Why is the defense spending so important?
(让我们再看看关于英国的新闻。为什么国防支出如此重要？)
[Aria] Because the world is not safe right now. Every country wants to be ready.
(因为世界现在不安全。每个国家都想做好准备。)
[Andrew] I see. It is about being able to protect your home.
(我明白了。这是关于能够保护你的家园。)
[Aria] Exactly. And when you have a war near you, you need to be very strong.
(没错。当你附近有战争时，你需要非常强大。)
[Andrew] It is a difficult time for many leaders. They have to make hard choices.
(这对许多领导人来说是一个困难的时期。他们必须做出艰难的选择。)
[Aria] I hope they can find peace soon. Peace is better than war.
(我希望他们能尽快找到和平。和平比战争好。)
[Andrew] I agree. Let us hope for a better tomorrow.
(我同意。让我们期待一个更美好的明天。)
[Aria] We have talked about many things today. From phones to space to war.
(我们今天谈了很多事情。从手机到太空再到战争。)
[Andrew] It shows how connected our world is. What happens in one place affects everyone.
(这表明我们的世界是多么紧密相连。一个地方发生的事情会影响每个人。)
[Aria] That is why learning English is so important. It helps us understand each other.
(这就是为什么学习英语如此重要。它帮助我们互相理解。)
[Andrew] Yes, we can share ideas and solve problems together.
(是的，我们可以分享想法并共同解决问题。)
[Aria] Thank you for being here with me, Andrew.
(谢谢你和我在一起，Andrew。)
[Andrew] It is my pleasure, Aria. I always like our talks.
(这是我的荣幸，Aria。我总是喜欢我们的谈话。)
[Aria] To our listeners, keep practicing. You are doing a great job.
(对我们的听众，继续练习。你们做得很好。)
[Andrew] See you next time!
(下次见！)
[Aria] See you!
(再见！)

item.title: 2026-06-11 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning everyone. Welcome to our daily news show. I am Aria.
(大家早上好。欢迎收听我们的每日新闻节目。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very full day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有非常丰富的新闻内容带给大家。)

[Aria] We will talk about Apple and their new machine learning work.
(我们将讨论苹果公司及其新的机器学习工作。)

[Andrew] Yes, and we have news about Valve and their gift cards.
(是的，我们还有关于 Valve 公司及其礼品卡的新闻。)

[Aria] We also have a story about space and clothes.
(我们还有一个关于太空和服装的故事。)

[Andrew] And we will look at the money market and some trouble in the world.
(我们还将关注金融市场以及世界上的一些麻烦。)

[Aria] Let us start with Apple. They have a new system for their machine learning.
(让我们从苹果公司开始。他们有一个新的机器学习系统。)

[Andrew] It is very interesting. The new system knows when to be quiet.
(这非常有趣。这个新系统知道什么时候该安静。)

[Aria] Many people use Siri every day. Sometimes Siri talks too much.
(很多人每天都在使用 Siri。有时 Siri 说话太多了。)

[Aria] Now, Apple says the new system is better at listening.
(现在，苹果公司表示新系统在倾听方面做得更好。)

[Andrew] This is part of a big change at Apple. They are in a race with other companies.
(这是苹果公司重大变革的一部分。他们正在与其他公司竞争。)

[Aria] The race is about who has the best artificial intelligence.
(这场竞争是关于谁拥有最好的人工智能。)

[Andrew] Apple is a dark horse. That means they might win even if people do not expect it.
(苹果是一匹黑马。这意味着即使人们没有预料到，他们也可能获胜。)

[Aria] They are also working with NVIDIA. This will help their private cloud.
(他们也在与英伟达合作。这将有助于他们的私有云。)

[Andrew] It is a smart move. Private cloud means the data stays safe.
(这是一个明智的举动。私有云意味着数据保持安全。)

[Aria] People care about their data. They do not want companies to see it.
(人们关心他们的数据。他们不希望公司看到这些数据。)

[Andrew] Apple knows this. They are building a system that is very private.
(苹果知道这一点。他们正在建立一个非常私密的系统。)

[Aria] Let us move to the next story. Valve is stopping their gift card program.
(让我们进入下一个故事。Valve 正在停止他们的礼品卡计划。)

[Andrew] This is because of bad people. They use the cards to take money from others.
(这是因为坏人。他们利用这些卡片从别人那里骗钱。)

[Aria] It is a shame. Many people liked to give these cards as gifts.
(真可惜。很多人喜欢把这些卡片作为礼物送人。)

[Andrew] But the scammers are too smart. Valve had to make a hard decision.
(但骗子太聪明了。Valve 不得不做出一个艰难的决定。)

[Aria] They will stop the physical cards by the end of the year.
(他们将在年底前停止实体卡。)

[Andrew] It is a good lesson for all of us. We must be careful with our money.
(这对我们所有人来说都是一个很好的教训。我们必须小心对待我们的钱。)

[Aria] Now, let us talk about the moon. NASA is working with Prada.
(现在，让我们谈谈月球。美国国家航空航天局正在与普拉达合作。)

[Andrew] Prada is a fashion company. Why are they making space clothes?
(普拉达是一家时尚公司。他们为什么要制作太空服？)

[Aria] They are making the suits for the Artemis mission.
(他们正在为阿尔忒弥斯任务制作宇航服。)

[Andrew] That is very cool. The astronauts will look very good on the moon.
(这太酷了。宇航员在月球上看起来会非常棒。)

[Aria] It is not just about looks. The suit must keep them cool and safe.
(这不仅仅是为了好看。宇航服必须让他们保持凉爽和安全。)

[Andrew] Space is a very hard place to be. The temperature changes a lot.
(太空是一个非常艰难的地方。温度变化很大。)

[Aria] Prada has the knowledge to make good material.
(普拉达有制造优质材料的知识。)

[Andrew] It shows that space is for everyone, even fashion designers.
(这表明太空属于每个人，甚至是时装设计师。)

[Aria] Let us look at the business news. Trump is talking about inflation.
(让我们看看商业新闻。特朗普正在谈论通货膨胀。)

[Andrew] He said he loves the inflation numbers. That is a strange thing to say.
(他说他喜欢通货膨胀数据。这真是一个奇怪的说法。)

[Aria] Many people are angry because prices are very high.
(很多人很生气，因为价格非常高。)

[Andrew] Yes, the cost of food and other things is going up.
(是的，食品和其他东西的成本正在上涨。)

[Aria] Trump is also angry at Iran. He said they will pay a price.
(特朗普也对伊朗感到愤怒。他说他们将付出代价。)

[Andrew] This makes the market very nervous. When there is war, stocks go down.
(这让市场非常紧张。当有战争时，股票就会下跌。)

[Aria] We saw the stock market drop today. The Dow fell a lot.
(我们今天看到股市下跌。道琼斯指数跌了很多。)

[Andrew] People are worried about the future. They are selling their stocks.
(人们担心未来。他们正在抛售股票。)

[Aria] And then there is SpaceX. People want to buy their stock.
(还有 SpaceX。人们想买他们的股票。)

[Andrew] It is a big company. Elon Musk is the owner.
(这是一家大公司。埃隆·马斯克是所有者。)

[Aria] Some people think it is a great investment. Others are not so sure.
(有些人认为这是一个很好的投资。其他人则不太确定。)

[Andrew] A man named Jim Chanos said it is just hopes and dreams.
(一个叫吉姆·查诺斯的人说这只是希望和梦想。)

[Aria] That is a strong opinion. Investing is always a risk.
(那是一个强烈的观点。投资总是有风险的。)

[Andrew] We must always do our own research before we buy anything.
(在购买任何东西之前，我们必须始终进行自己的研究。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the world. There is a big church in Barcelona.
(让我们谈谈世界。巴塞罗那有一座大教堂。)

[Andrew] The Sagrada Familia. It is a very famous building.
(圣家堂。这是一个非常著名的建筑。)

[Aria] The Pope went there to give it a blessing.
(教皇去了那里进行祝福。)

[Andrew] It took a very long time to build. It is a work of art.
(它花了很长时间才建成。这是一件艺术品。)

[Aria] Some people love it, but some people think it is strange.
(有些人喜欢它，但有些人认为它很奇怪。)

[Andrew] That is the beauty of art. Everyone sees it in a different way.
(这就是艺术的美。每个人以不同的方式看待它。)

[Aria] Now, let us look at Canada. They have a new plan for children.
(现在，让我们看看加拿大。他们有一个针对儿童的新计划。)

[Andrew] They want to stop children from using social media.
(他们想阻止儿童使用社交媒体。)

[Aria] They are making a law for people under 16.
(他们正在为 16 岁以下的人制定法律。)

[Andrew] This is a big step. Many countries are thinking about this.
(这是一个大步骤。许多国家都在考虑这一点。)

[Aria] Social media can be bad for young minds.
(社交媒体对年轻人的思想可能有害。)

[Andrew] But it is hard to control. How will they stop it?
(但它很难控制。他们将如何阻止它？)

[Aria] The law will force companies to change their systems.
(法律将迫使公司改变他们的系统。)

[Andrew] It will be interesting to see if it works.
(看看它是否有效将会很有趣。)

[Aria] Finally, there is trouble in Northern Ireland.
(最后，北爱尔兰出现了麻烦。)

[Andrew] There was a fight in the street. The police had to use water.
(街上发生了打斗。警察不得不使用水炮。)

[Aria] It is a sad situation. People are very angry about many things.
(这是一个悲伤的情况。人们对很多事情感到非常愤怒。)

[Andrew] We hope that things will get better soon. Peace is important.
(我们希望情况能很快好转。和平很重要。)

[Aria] That is all the news for today. Thank you for listening.
(这就是今天的所有新闻。谢谢大家的收听。)

(我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。祝大家有美好的一天。)

[Aria] Remember to keep learning and keep listening.
(记得继续学习，继续倾听。)

[Andrew] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)

[Aria] Goodbye.
(再见。)

[Andrew] Let us talk more about the Apple news. It is very important for the future.
(让我们多谈谈苹果的新闻。这对未来非常重要。)

[Aria] Yes, artificial intelligence is changing everything.
(是的，人工智能正在改变一切。)

[Andrew] Even the way we talk to our phones.
(甚至是我们与手机交谈的方式。)

[Aria] Siri is becoming more like a person.
(Siri 变得越来越像一个人。)

[Andrew] But a person who knows when to be quiet.
(但一个知道什么时候该安静的人。)

[Aria] That is a good quality in a person too.
(这也是一个人应有的好品质。)

[Andrew] I agree. Sometimes we talk too much.
(我同意。有时我们说得太多了。)

[Aria] Let us go back to the SpaceX story. Why are people so excited?
(让我们回到 SpaceX 的故事。为什么人们如此兴奋？)

[Andrew] Because space is the next big thing.
(因为太空是下一个大事件。)

[Aria] People want to be part of the future.
(人们想成为未来的一部分。)

[Andrew] And they want to make money from it.
(而且他们想从中赚钱。)

[Aria] But it is a long way to the moon.
(但去月球的路很长。)

[Andrew] And it is a long way to make a profit.
(而且盈利的路也很长。)

[Aria] That is why some people are worried.
(这就是为什么有些人很担心。)

[Andrew] But that is business. It is always a risk.
(但这就是生意。它总是有风险的。)

[Aria] What about the Prada space suit? Do you think it is expensive?
(普拉达的宇航服怎么样？你觉得它贵吗？)

[Andrew] Oh, very expensive. Prada is a luxury brand.
(哦，非常贵。普拉达是一个奢侈品牌。)

[Aria] But NASA needs the best.
(但美国国家航空航天局需要最好的。)

[Andrew] If it keeps the astronauts safe, it is worth the price.
(如果它能保证宇航员的安全，那么它就值这个价。)

[Aria] Safety is the most important thing in space.
(安全是太空中最重要的事情。)

[Andrew] I agree. We cannot have accidents in space.
(我同意。我们不能在太空中发生事故。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the inflation again. It is a big problem.
(让我们再谈谈通货膨胀。这是一个大问题。)

[Andrew] Yes, it makes life hard for many families.
(是的，它让许多家庭的生活变得艰难。)

[Aria] When food is expensive, people have less money for other things.
(当食物昂贵时，人们用于其他事情的钱就少了。)

[Andrew] And when money is tight, people get angry.
(当钱紧张时，人们就会生气。)

[Aria] That is why the government must act.
(这就是为什么政府必须采取行动。)

[Andrew] But it is not easy to fix.
(但它并不容易解决。)

[Aria] No, it takes time and good decisions.
(不，这需要时间和好的决定。)

[Andrew] Let us talk about the Sagrada Familia. Have you ever been there?
(让我们谈谈圣家堂。你去过那里吗？)

[Aria] No, but I have seen pictures. It is beautiful.
(没有，但我看过照片。它很美。)

[Andrew] It looks like a building from a dream.
(它看起来像梦中的建筑。)

[Aria] The shapes are very different from normal buildings.
(这些形状与普通建筑非常不同。)

[Andrew] That is why it is so famous.
(这就是它如此著名的原因。)

[Aria] It is good that the Pope went to see it.
(教皇去看了它很好。)

[Andrew] It brings attention to the art and the history.
(它引起了人们对艺术和历史的关注。)

[Aria] And it brings people together.
(它把人们聚集在一起。)

[Andrew] That is what we need in the world today.
(这就是我们今天在世界上所需要的。)

[Aria] We need more peace and more art.
(我们需要更多的和平和更多的艺术。)

[Andrew] And less fighting in the streets.
(以及更少的街头打斗。)

[Aria] The news in Northern Ireland is very sad.
(北爱尔兰的新闻非常令人难过。)

[Andrew] We hope the people there can find a way to talk.
(我们希望那里的人们能找到一种交谈的方式。)

[Aria] Talking is better than fighting.
(交谈比打架好。)

[Andrew] Always.
(总是如此。)

[Aria] We have talked about many things today.
(我们今天谈了很多事情。)

[Andrew] Technology, space, business, and world events.
(技术、太空、商业和世界事件。)

[Aria] It is important to know what is happening.
(了解正在发生的事情很重要。)

[Andrew] It helps us understand the world better.
(它帮助我们更好地了解世界。)

[Aria] And it helps us learn English too.
(它也帮助我们学习英语。)

[Andrew] Yes, the more we listen, the better we get.
(是的，我们听得越多，我们就越好。)

[Aria] Our listeners are doing a great job.
(我们的听众做得很好。)

[Andrew] They are learning new words every day.
(他们每天都在学习新单词。)

[Aria] And they are learning about the world.
(他们也在了解世界。)

[Andrew] That is the goal of this show.
(这就是本节目的目标。)

[Aria] To learn and to grow together.
(一起学习，一起成长。)

[Andrew] I am happy to be here with you, Aria.
(我很高兴能和你在这里，Aria。)

[Aria] I am happy too, Andrew.
(我也很高兴，Andrew。)

[Andrew] We have a good team.
(我们有一个好的团队。)

[Aria] We do. And we have great listeners.
(是的。而且我们有很棒的听众。)

[Andrew] Let us finish for today.
(让我们今天结束吧。)

[Aria] Yes, let us rest and get ready for tomorrow.
(是的，让我们休息一下，为明天做好准备。)

[Andrew] See you all tomorrow.
(明天见。)

[Aria] Goodbye everyone.
(再见大家。)

[Andrew] Keep learning.
(继续学习。)

[Aria] Keep growing.
(继续成长。)

[Andrew] And keep listening to the news.
(并继续收听新闻。)

[Aria] It is the best way to start the day.
(这是开始新的一天的最好方式。)

[Andrew] Have a wonderful day.
(祝你有美好的一天。)

[Aria] See you soon.
(很快再见。)

[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)

[Aria] Goodbye.
(再见。)

item.title: 2026-06-12 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning and welcome to our daily news talk. I am Aria.
(早上好，欢迎收听我们的每日新闻谈话。我是 Aria。)
[Andrew] And I am Andrew. Today we have a very long list of important things to talk about.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有一个很长的重要事项清单要讨论。)
[Aria] Yes, Andrew. We have news about Apple, the space business, and some big changes in the world. Let us start with Apple.
(是的，Andrew。我们有关于苹果、太空商业以及世界重大变化的新闻。让我们从苹果开始。)
[Andrew] Apple is making big changes to its smart machines. They have a new system for their artificial brain. But there is a catch. It will only work on the newest machines.
(苹果正在对其智能设备进行重大调整。他们为人工智能系统准备了新方案。但有一个问题。它只能在最新的设备上运行。)
[Aria] That is right. Many people are talking about this. If you have an old machine, you cannot use the new system. This makes people think about buying new things.
(没错。很多人都在谈论这件事。如果你有旧设备，你就不能使用这个新系统。这让人们考虑购买新产品。)
[Andrew] It is a common strategy for Apple. They want to keep their business strong. By making the new system only for new machines, they push people to spend money.
(这是苹果常用的策略。他们想保持业务强劲。通过让新系统仅适用于新设备，他们推动人们花钱。)
[Aria] Let us look at the list of these machines. It is quite long. But it is important for users to know if their machine is on the list.
(让我们看看这些设备的清单。它很长。但用户知道自己的设备是否在清单上很重要。)
[Andrew] Also, there is news about the Apple Watch. The new system for the watch is coming. It will make the watch work better in seven ways.
(此外，还有关于 Apple Watch 的新闻。新手表系统即将到来。它将通过七种方式让手表表现更好。)
[Aria] I think that is good. People want their watches to be fast and strong. But some old watches will not run this new system.
(我认为这很好。人们希望他们的手表快速且强劲。但一些旧手表将无法运行这个新系统。)
[Aria] Now, let us move to the big news about space. Elon Musk and his company, SpaceX, are in the news today.
(现在，让我们转向关于太空的重大新闻。Elon Musk 和他的公司 SpaceX 今天上了新闻。)
[Andrew] This is a very big story. SpaceX has started to sell its part of the company to the public. This is called an IPO.
(这是一个非常大的新闻。SpaceX 已经开始向公众出售其公司股份。这被称为 IPO。)
[Aria] Because of this, Elon Musk is now the first person in the world to have a trillion dollars. That is a very large amount of money.
(因此，Elon Musk 现在是世界上第一个拥有万亿美元的人。那是一笔非常巨大的钱。)
[Andrew] It is hard to even think about that amount. The market is very excited. People are waiting to see the price of the shares.
(甚至很难想象那个数额。市场非常兴奋。人们都在等待查看股票价格。)
[Aria] There is also talk about a possible connection between SpaceX and Tesla. Some people think they might join together.
(还有关于 SpaceX 和 Tesla 之间可能存在的联系的讨论。有些人认为他们可能会合并。)
[Andrew] If they join, it would be a very big change for the business world. The president of SpaceX, Gwynne Shotwell, talked about this today.
(如果他们合并，这对商业世界将是一个巨大的变化。SpaceX 总裁 Gwynne Shotwell 今天谈到了这一点。)
[Aria] It is interesting to see how these companies grow. They are changing how we look at space and travel.
(看到这些公司如何成长很有趣。他们正在改变我们看待太空和旅行的方式。)
[Andrew] Let us talk about the oil market. Oil prices went down today. This is because of news about a deal between the United States and Iran.
(让我们谈谈石油市场。今天油价下跌了。这是因为关于美国和伊朗之间达成协议的消息。)
[Aria] A deal could mean more oil for the world. If there is more oil, the price goes down. This is how the market works.
(协议可能意味着世界会有更多的石油。如果石油更多，价格就会下降。市场就是这样运作的。)
[Andrew] Yes, and this is good for people who drive cars or use machines that need oil. It makes life a little cheaper.
(是的，这对开车或使用需要石油的机器的人来说是好事。它让生活变得稍微便宜了一些。)
[Aria] Now, let us look at the world of games. Minecraft has a new version coming out. It is called the release candidate.
(现在，让我们看看游戏世界。Minecraft 有一个新版本即将推出。它被称为候选发布版。)
[Andrew] Minecraft is a very popular game. People of all ages like to play it. This new version will fix some problems and make the game better.
(Minecraft 是一款非常受欢迎的游戏。所有年龄段的人都喜欢玩它。这个新版本将修复一些问题并使游戏更好。)
[Aria] It is great to see games get better over time. It keeps people interested and happy.
(看到游戏随着时间推移变得更好真是太棒了。它让人们保持兴趣和快乐。)
[Aria] Let us talk about the European Union. They have new rules for people who want to come to their countries. These are called migration and asylum rules.
(让我们谈谈欧盟。他们为想要来到他们国家的人制定了新规则。这些被称为移民和庇护规则。)
[Andrew] These rules are very important. They change how the countries handle people who are looking for a new home.
(这些规则非常重要。它们改变了各国处理寻找新家园的人的方式。)
[Aria] Some people think these rules are good because they make things clear. Others are worried about the people who need help.
(有些人认为这些规则很好，因为它们让事情变得清晰。另一些人则担心那些需要帮助的人。)
[Aria] It is a difficult subject. There are many different opinions about what is right and what is wrong.
(这是一个困难的话题。对于什么是对的，什么是错的，有很多不同的意见。)
[Andrew] That is true. It is a big change for Europe. We will have to see how it works in the future.
(确实如此。这对欧洲来说是一个巨大的变化。我们将不得不看看它在未来如何运作。)
[Aria] Now, let us go to the United Kingdom. There is a special election happening there. People are not happy with the current state of things.
(现在，让我们去英国。那里正在进行一场特别选举。人们对现状不满意。)
[Andrew] Yes, the voters want change. They are angry about many things, like the cost of living and the way the government works.
(是的，选民想要改变。他们对很多事情感到愤怒，比如生活成本和政府运作方式。)
[Aria] It is a very important time for the country. The people will decide who they want to lead them.
(这对国家来说是一个非常重要的时刻。人民将决定他们想要谁来领导他们。)
[Andrew] Let us move to Ukraine and Russia. There is a war happening there. Ukraine is using new drones to stop Russian supply lines.
(让我们转向乌克兰和俄罗斯。那里正在发生战争。乌克兰正在使用新的无人机来阻止俄罗斯的补给线。)
[Aria] These drones are very effective. They can hit bridges and other important things. This makes it hard for Russia to move their army.
(这些无人机非常有效。它们可以击中桥梁和其他重要目标。这使得俄罗斯很难调动他们的军队。)
[Andrew] It is a sad situation. Many people are suffering because of the war. We hope for peace soon.
(这是一个悲伤的情况。许多人因为战争而受苦。我们希望很快能有和平。)
[Aria] Finally, let us talk about South Korea. The former president, Yoon, has been sent to prison.
(最后，让我们谈谈韩国。前总统尹锡悦已被送进监狱。)
[Andrew] This is a very big event in South Korea. He was sent to prison because of a plan involving drones over Pyongyang.
(这是韩国的一件大事。他因为一个涉及平壤上空无人机的计划而被送进监狱。)
[Aria] It shows that no one is above the law. Even a president must follow the rules.
(这表明没有人能凌驾于法律之上。即使是总统也必须遵守规则。)
[Andrew] It is a very serious matter. The people of South Korea are watching this very closely.
(这是一件非常严肃的事情。韩国人民正在密切关注这一点。)
[Aria] We have covered a lot of ground today. We talked about Apple, space, oil, games, and world politics.
(我们今天涵盖了很多内容。我们谈到了苹果、太空、石油、游戏和世界政治。)
[Andrew] Yes, it was a very busy day for news. It is important to stay informed about what is happening in the world.
(是的，今天的新闻非常繁忙。了解世界上正在发生的事情很重要。)
[Aria] Thank you for listening to our podcast. We will be back tomorrow with more news.
(感谢收听我们的播客。我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。)
[Andrew] Have a great day, everyone. Keep learning and keep listening.
(祝大家度过愉快的一天。继续学习，继续收听。)
[Aria] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)
[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)
[Aria] Let us talk more about the Apple news. It is very interesting how they control their market.
(让我们多谈谈苹果的新闻。他们控制市场的方式非常有趣。)
[Andrew] They have a very strong position. Because they make both the machine and the system, they have a lot of power.
(他们拥有非常强大的地位。因为他们既制造机器又制造系统，所以他们拥有很大的权力。)
[Aria] And the users are often very loyal. They like the way Apple products work together.
(而且用户通常非常忠诚。他们喜欢苹果产品协同工作的方式。)
[Andrew] That is true. It is like a closed circle. Once you are in, it is hard to leave.
(确实如此。这就像一个封闭的圆圈。一旦你进去了，就很难离开。)
[Aria] But this can also be a problem. If the company makes a bad choice, the users have no other way to go.
(但这也可能是一个问题。如果公司做出了错误的决定，用户就没有其他路可走。)
[Aria] Let us look at the space news again. The idea of a SpaceX and Tesla merger is very bold.
(让我们再看看太空新闻。SpaceX 和 Tesla 合并的想法非常大胆。)
[Andrew] It is. Elon Musk is known for his big ideas. He wants to change the future of the world.
(确实。Elon Musk 以他的宏大想法而闻名。他想改变世界的未来。)
[Aria] If he can combine the energy of Tesla with the space power of SpaceX, it could be very strong.
(如果他能将 Tesla 的能源与 SpaceX 的太空力量结合起来，那可能会非常强大。)
[Andrew] But it is also very risky. Both companies are very different.
(但这也非常冒险。两家公司非常不同。)
[Aria] That is the nature of business. You have to take risks to get big results.
(这就是商业的本质。你必须承担风险才能获得巨大的成果。)
[Aria] What about the oil market? Do you think the price will stay low?
(石油市场怎么样？你认为价格会保持低位吗？)
[Andrew] It is hard to say. The market is very sensitive to news. If the deal with Iran goes well, the price might stay low.
(很难说。市场对新闻非常敏感。如果与伊朗的协议进展顺利，价格可能会保持低位。)
[Aria] But if there is more trouble, the price could go up again.
(但如果有更多麻烦，价格可能会再次上涨。)
[Andrew] Exactly. That is why the market is always changing.
(没错。这就是为什么市场总是在变化。)
[Aria] I am interested in the Minecraft news. It is amazing how a game can stay popular for so long.
(我对 Minecraft 的新闻很感兴趣。一款游戏能保持这么长时间的流行真是太神奇了。)
[Aria] It is because it is like a digital box of blocks. You can build anything you want.
(这是因为它就像一个数字积木盒。你可以建造任何你想要的东西。)
[Andrew] It is a great tool for learning and creativity. Children and adults both love it.
(它是学习和创造力的好工具。孩子和成年人都喜欢它。)
[Aria] And the developers are always adding new things. That keeps it fresh.
(而且开发者总是在添加新东西。这让它保持新鲜感。)
[Andrew] That is the key to success in the game business. You must keep the players happy.
(这就是游戏业务成功的关键。你必须让玩家保持快乐。)
[Aria] Let us talk about the migration rules in Europe again. It is a very complex issue.
(让我们再谈谈欧洲的移民规则。这是一个非常复杂的问题。)
[Aria] Every country has its own needs. It is hard to find an agreement that makes everyone happy.
(每个国家都有自己的需求。很难找到一个让每个人都满意的协议。)
[Andrew] That is the challenge of the European Union. They have to balance the needs of many different nations.
(这就是欧盟的挑战。他们必须平衡许多不同国家的需求。)
[Aria] And they have to do it in a way that is fair and kind.
(而且他们必须以公平和友善的方式来做。)
[Andrew] It is not an easy job. But they are trying to find a way forward.
(这不是一件容易的工作。但他们正在努力寻找前进的方向。)
[Aria] The UK election is also very interesting. It shows how people feel about their government.
(英国选举也非常有趣。它显示了人们对政府的感受。)
[Andrew] When people are angry, they want to see a change. That is what we are seeing in the UK.
(当人们愤怒时，他们想要看到改变。这就是我们在英国所看到的。)
[Aria] It is a healthy part of a democracy. People have the right to say what they think.
(这是民主健康的一部分。人们有权说出他们的想法。)
[Andrew] And the government must listen to them. If they do not, they will lose the election.
(政府必须倾听他们的声音。如果他们不这样做，他们就会输掉选举。)
[Aria] That is the power of the vote.
(这就是投票的力量。)
[Aria] Let us go back to the Ukraine war. The use of drones is changing the way wars are fought.
(让我们回到乌克兰战争。无人机的使用正在改变战争的打法。)
[Andrew] It is a new kind of war. It is more about technology than just the number of soldiers.
(这是一种新型战争。它更多是关于技术，而不仅仅是士兵的数量。)
[Aria] And it is very dangerous. The drones can be very precise.
(而且非常危险。无人机可以非常精确。)
[Andrew] It is a sad reality of our modern world. Technology is used for both good and bad things.
(这是我们现代世界的一个悲伤现实。技术既用于好事，也用于坏事。)
[Aria] We must hope that the good use of technology will win in the end.
(我们必须希望技术的良好应用最终会获胜。)
[Aria] Finally, the situation in South Korea. It is a reminder that the law is important.
(最后，韩国的情况。这提醒我们法律很重要。)
[Andrew] Yes, no matter how high your position is, you are still a person under the law.
(是的，无论你的职位有多高，你仍然是法律之下的人。)
[Aria] It is a lesson for all leaders around the world.
(这对全世界所有的领导人来说都是一个教训。)
[Andrew] I agree. It is important to be honest and follow the rules.
(我同意。诚实并遵守规则很重要。)
[Aria] We have had a very deep discussion today. I think our listeners will learn a lot.
(我们今天进行了非常深入的讨论。我想我们的听众会学到很多。)
[Andrew] I hope so. It is always good to think about these things.
(我也希望如此。思考这些事情总是好的。)
[Aria] We will be here again tomorrow to talk about more news.
(我们明天会再次在这里讨论更多新闻。)
[Andrew] I look forward to it.
(我很期待。)
[Aria] Have a good night, Andrew.
(晚安，Andrew。)
[Andrew] Good night, Aria.
(晚安，Aria。)
[Aria] And to all our listeners, thank you for being with us today.
(对于我们所有的听众，感谢你们今天与我们在一起。)
[Andrew] Keep learning English and keep following the news.
(继续学习英语，继续关注新闻。)
[Aria] We will see you tomorrow.
(我们明天见。)
[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)

item.title: 2026-06-12 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning and welcome to our daily news program. I am Aria.
(早上好，欢迎收听我们的每日新闻节目。我是 Aria。)
[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very full day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有非常丰富的新闻内容要带给大家。)
[Aria] We will start with music and technology. A company named Deezer has a new tool. It can find music made by a machine.
(我们先从音乐和科技开始。一家叫 Deezer 的公司有一个新工具。它可以找出由机器制作的音乐。)
[Andrew] This is important because many people now use computers to make songs. Some people think this is not real art.
(这一点很重要，因为现在很多人用电脑写歌。有些人认为这并不是真正的艺术。)
[Aria] That is true. The tool works on big music services like Spotify and Apple Music. You can put your list of songs into the tool. It will tell you if the music is from a machine.
(确实如此。这个工具适用于像 Spotify 和 Apple Music 这样的大型音乐服务。你可以把你听的歌单放进这个工具里。它会告诉你这些音乐是否来自机器。)
[Andrew] It is a free tool. Many people want to know if their favorite songs are human or machine. This tool gives them that answer.
(这是一个免费工具。很多人想知道他们最喜欢的歌是人唱的还是机器做的。这个工具给了他们答案。)
[Aria] Let us move to another story. Some people say that data from the game Pokemon Go was used in a bad way.
(让我们转到另一个故事。有些人说 Pokemon Go 游戏的数据被以不好的方式使用了。)
[Andrew] Yes, there was a report about this. People thought the game sent information to a company that makes drones.
(是的，有一个关于此的报道。人们认为这个游戏把信息发给了一家制造无人机的公司。)
[Aria] The company that makes the game, Niantic, said this is not true. They said they did not share the data.
(制作这个游戏的 Niantic 公司说这不是真的。他们说他们没有分享这些数据。)
[Andrew] This is a big deal because people care about their private information. When we play games on our phones, we give the game a lot of information.
(这是一件大事，因为人们关心他们的私人信息。当我们用手机玩游戏时，我们给了游戏很多信息。)
[Aria] We should always be careful with our data. Even if a game is fun, we must know where our information goes.
(我们应该总是小心我们的数据。即使游戏很有趣，我们也必须知道我们的信息去了哪里。)
[Andrew] Now, let us talk about Telegram. It is a popular way to send messages. They have a new app for watches.
(现在，让我们谈谈 Telegram。这是一种流行的发送信息的方式。他们有一个新手表应用。)
[Aria] That is right. After five years, they have a new app for Wear OS. You can now see your messages on your wrist.
(没错。五年后，他们有了新的 Wear OS 应用。你现在可以在手腕上看到你的信息了。)
[Andrew] It is very good for people who are always on the move. You do not need to take your phone out of your pocket.
(这对总是走动的人来说非常好。你不需要把手机从口袋里拿出来。)
[Aria] Reddit also has news today. They now let people put videos in the comments.
(Reddit 今天也有新闻。他们现在允许人们在评论里放视频。)
[Andrew] That is a big change. Before, you could only write words. Now, you can show a video to explain your thought.
(这是一个巨大的改变。以前，你只能写字。现在，你可以用视频来解释你的想法。)
[Aria] It will make the talk on Reddit more interesting. But it might also make it harder to read.
(这会让 Reddit 上的讨论更有趣。但这也可能让阅读变得更难。)
[Andrew] Let us move to business. SpaceX is a very famous company that sends things into space. They have a new price for their stock.
(让我们转到商业。SpaceX 是一家非常有名的把东西送入太空的公司。他们的股票有一个新价格。)
[Aria] Yes, the price is 135 dollars for one part of the company. Many people want to buy this stock.
(是的，价格是每股 135 美元。很多人想买这个股票。)
[Andrew] It is the biggest sale of stock in a long time. People believe in the future of space travel.
(这是很长一段时间以来最大的一次股票发售。人们相信太空旅行的未来。)
[Aria] But there is also some bad news about money. The cost of things is going up in the United States.
(但也有一些关于钱的坏消息。在美国，东西的价格正在上涨。)
[Andrew] We call this inflation. It is the biggest jump in three years. Energy prices are very high right now.
(我们称之为通货膨胀。这是三年来的最大涨幅。能源价格现在非常高。)
[Aria] When energy is expensive, everything becomes expensive. This is hard for families who have little money.
(当能源昂贵时，一切都变得昂贵。这对钱不多的家庭来说很困难。)
[Andrew] There was also a strange event in New York. Someone put a big model of Elon Musk in the middle of the city.
(纽约还发生了一件奇怪的事。有人在城市中心放了一个巨大的 Elon Musk 模型。)
[Aria] It was a protest. They do not like the new AI tool from his company. It is called Grok.
(那是一场抗议。他们不喜欢他公司的新 AI 工具。它叫 Grok。)
[Andrew] People are worried about how AI is used. They want more control over these new tools.
(人们担心 AI 是如何被使用的。他们想要对这些新工具有更多的控制权。)
[Aria] Let us talk about health. Some older people need help after they are sick. They go to a place for care.
(让我们谈谈健康。一些老年人在生病后需要帮助。他们去一个地方接受护理。)
[Andrew] But their insurance companies are saying no. They do not want to pay for the care.
(但他们的保险公司说不。他们不想为这些护理付费。)
[Aria] This is very sad. These people worked all their lives. They should have the care they need.
(这非常令人难过。这些人工作了一辈子。他们应该得到他们需要的护理。)
[Andrew] It is a problem with the system. We need to make sure that everyone can get the help they need when they are old.
(这是系统的问题。我们需要确保每个人在年老时都能得到他们需要的帮助。)
[Aria] Now, let us look at the world. In China, people are not buying as many cars as before.
(现在，让我们看看世界。在中国，人们买的车没有以前多了。)
[Andrew] That is a sign that the economy is changing. People are being more careful with their money.
(这是一个经济正在改变的信号。人们在花钱时变得更加小心了。)
[Aria] In Northern Ireland, there is a lot of trouble. There was a fight that led to riots.
(在北爱尔兰，有很多麻烦。发生了一场导致骚乱的打斗。)
[Andrew] It is a very dangerous situation. People are afraid to go out on the street.
(这是一个非常危险的情况。人们害怕走到街上。)
[Aria] We hope that things get better soon. Peace is very important for everyone.
(我们希望事情能很快好转。和平对每个人来说都很重要。)
[Andrew] Also, in the United Kingdom, a leader of the military quit his job. He says the government is not spending enough money on safety.
(另外，在英国，一位军事领导人辞职了。他说政府在安全方面花的钱不够。)
[Aria] This is a big blow to the government. They need to keep the country safe, but they have to watch their money.
(这对政府是一个巨大的打击。他们需要保持国家安全，但他们必须看紧他们的钱。)
[Andrew] It is a hard balance to find. You want to be safe, but you also need to have money for other things.
(这是一个很难找到的平衡。你想要安全，但你也需要有钱做其他事情。)
[Aria] Finally, let us talk about Ukraine. They are hitting bridges to stop the other side.
(最后，让我们谈谈乌克兰。他们正在打击桥梁以阻止另一方。)
[Andrew] It is a war that has been going on for a long time. It is very hard for the people who live there.
(这是一场已经持续了很长时间的战争。这对住在那里的人来说非常困难。)
[Aria] We see news about empty shelves in shops. People cannot get the food they need.
(我们看到关于商店货架空空如也的新闻。人们无法得到他们需要的食物。)
[Andrew] It is a very sad situation. We hope for a quick end to the fighting.
(这是一个非常悲伤的情况。我们希望战斗能很快结束。)
[Aria] And there is one more story. The United States wants to send some people back to a country in Africa.
(还有一个故事。美国想把一些人送回非洲的一个国家。)
[Andrew] These people are from Iran. But they are being sent to the Central African Republic.
(这些人来自伊朗。但他们被送往中非共和国。)
[Aria] People say this is not safe. That country has a lot of violence.
(人们说这不安全。那个国家有很多暴力。)
[Andrew] It is a very complex issue. Laws about people moving from one country to another are very hard.
(这是一个非常复杂的问题。关于人们从一个国家搬到另一个国家的法律非常困难。)
[Aria] We have covered a lot of news today. From technology to world events, everything is changing fast.
(我们今天报道了很多新闻。从科技到世界大事，一切都在快速改变。)
[Andrew] That is why it is important to stay informed. We hope you learned something new today.
(这就是为什么保持了解很重要。我们希望你今天学到了一些新东西。)
[Aria] Thank you for listening to our podcast. We will be back tomorrow with more news.
(感谢收听我们的播客。我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。)
[Andrew] Have a great day and keep learning English. It is a great way to understand the world.
(祝你有美好的一天，继续学习英语。这是了解世界的好方法。)
[Aria] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)
[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)
[Aria] Let us talk more about the music tool. Why is it so important?
(让我们多谈谈那个音乐工具。为什么它这么重要？)
[Andrew] Because music is a big part of our life. When a machine makes music, it is not the same as a person.
(因为音乐是我们生活的重要部分。当机器制作音乐时，它和人是不一样的。)
[Aria] A person has feelings. A machine only has data.
(人有感情。机器只有数据。)
[Andrew] Exactly. A person can put their heart into a song. A machine just follows a rule.
(没错。人可以把心投入到歌里。机器只是遵循规则。)
[Aria] Some people think machine music is good because it is cheap. But is it art?
(有些人认为机器音乐很好，因为它便宜。但那是艺术吗？)
[Andrew] That is the question. Maybe it is a new kind of art.
(这就是问题所在。也许这是一种新的艺术。)
[Aria] I think I prefer music made by a person. It feels more real.
(我想我更喜欢人做的音乐。它感觉更真实。)
[Andrew] I agree. Now, back to the game Pokemon Go. Do you play it?
(我同意。现在，回到 Pokemon Go 游戏。你玩吗？)
[Aria] I did play it a long time ago. It was fun to walk around and find the little animals.
(我很久以前玩过。走来走去寻找小动物很有趣。)
[Andrew] It was very popular. But now we know that the game collects a lot of data.
(它曾经非常流行。但现在我们知道这个游戏收集了很多数据。)
[Aria] Every time we move, the game knows where we are. That is a lot of power for one company.
(每次我们移动，游戏都知道我们在哪里。这对一家公司来说是很大的权力。)
[Andrew] And if that data goes to the military, it is even more serious.
(如果这些数据流向军队，那就更严重了。)
[Aria] We must be careful about what we share. Our location is private.
(我们必须小心我们分享的东西。我们的位置是私人的。)
[Andrew] Let us talk about the Telegram app again. Do you use it?
(让我们再谈谈 Telegram 应用。你用吗？)
[Aria] I use it to talk to my friends in other countries. It is very fast.
(我用它和在其他国家的朋友聊天。它非常快。)
[Andrew] And now you can use it on your watch. That is very cool.
(现在你可以在手表上用它了。那很酷。)
[Aria] Technology is making our life easier. But sometimes it is too much.
(科技让我们的生活更简单。但有时它太多了。)
[Andrew] You are right. Sometimes I want to turn off my phone and just be quiet.
(你说得对。有时我想关掉手机，安静一下。)
[Aria] That is a good idea. We all need a break from the news and the noise.
(那是个好主意。我们都需要从新闻和噪音中休息一下。)
[Andrew] Let us talk about the Reddit video comments. Do you think it is a good idea?
(让我们谈谈 Reddit 的视频评论。你觉得这是个好主意吗？)
[Aria] It depends. If the video is helpful, it is good. If it is just noise, it is bad.
(看情况。如果视频有帮助，那是好的。如果只是噪音，那是坏的。)
[Andrew] People can be very creative with video. They can show things instead of just saying them.
(人们在视频方面可以非常有创意。他们可以展示东西，而不是只说出来。)
[Aria] That is true. A picture is worth a thousand words. A video is worth even more.
(确实。一张图片胜过千言万语。一个视频胜过更多。)
[Andrew] But it will take more time to watch all the comments.
(但这会花更多时间去看所有的评论。)
[Aria] Yes, that is a problem. We have so little time.
(是的，那是个问题。我们的时间太少了。)
[Andrew] Let us talk about the SpaceX stock. Would you buy it?
(让我们谈谈 SpaceX 的股票。你会买吗？)
[Aria] I do not know much about stocks. It sounds risky.
(我对股票了解不多。听起来有风险。)
[Andrew] All stocks are risky. But space is the future.
(所有股票都有风险。但太空是未来。)
[Aria] Maybe. But I prefer to keep my money in a safe place.
(也许吧。但我更喜欢把钱放在安全的地方。)
[Andrew] That is a wise choice. Not everyone should buy stocks.
(那是一个明智的选择。不是每个人都应该买股票。)
[Aria] What about the inflation? How do you feel about prices going up?
(通货膨胀怎么样？你对价格上涨有什么感觉？)
[Andrew] It is hard. I have to spend more money for the same food.
(很难。我得花更多的钱买同样的食物。)
[Aria] We all feel that. It is a common problem right now.
(我们都有同感。这是现在一个普遍的问题。)
[Andrew] I hope the government can do something to help.
(我希望政府能做点什么来帮忙。)
[Aria] They are trying. But it is not easy to fix the economy.
(他们正在尝试。但修复经济并不容易。)
[Andrew] It takes time. We have to be patient.
(这需要时间。我们必须有耐心。)
[Aria] Let us talk about the Elon Musk protest. Why do people hate him?
(让我们谈谈 Elon Musk 的抗议。为什么人们讨厌他？)
[Andrew] He is a very powerful man. Some people think he has too much power.
(他是一个非常有权势的人。有些人认为他权力太大了。)
[Aria] And he is always in the news. People have strong feelings about him.
(而且他总是在新闻里。人们对他有强烈的感情。)
[Andrew] Some people love him. Some people hate him. There is no middle ground.
(有些人爱他。有些人恨他。没有中间地带。)
[Aria] That is the life of a famous person. Everyone has an opinion.
(这就是名人的生活。每个人都有意见。)
[Andrew] Let us talk about the Medicare story. It is very sad.
(让我们谈谈 Medicare 的故事。它非常令人难过。)
[Aria] Yes, old people should be treated well. They have given so much to society.
(是的，老年人应该被善待。他们为社会贡献了很多。)
[Andrew] When they are sick, they need care. If the insurance says no, they suffer.
(当他们生病时，他们需要护理。如果保险公司说不，他们就会受苦。)
[Aria] We need a better system. A system that cares about people, not just money.
(我们需要一个更好的系统。一个关心人，而不仅仅是钱的系统。)
[Andrew] I agree. That should be the goal of any government.
(我同意。那应该是任何政府的目标。)
[Aria] Let us talk about China and the car demand. Why are people not buying cars?
(让我们谈谈中国和汽车需求。为什么人们不买车了？)
[Andrew] Maybe they already have a car. Or maybe they are saving money.
(也许他们已经有车了。或者也许他们在存钱。)
[Aria] Or maybe they are using other ways to travel. Like trains or bikes.
(或者也许他们在用其他方式旅行。比如火车或自行车。)
[Andrew] That is possible. The world is changing how we move.
(那是有可能的。世界正在改变我们移动的方式。)
[Aria] Let us talk about Northern Ireland. It is a beautiful place.
(让我们谈谈北爱尔兰。那是一个美丽的地方。)
[Andrew] It is. It is sad to see violence there.
(确实。看到那里的暴力令人难过。)
[Aria] I hope the people there can find peace. They deserve it.
(我希望那里的人们能找到和平。他们值得拥有。)
[Andrew] Everyone deserves peace. No matter where they live.
(每个人都值得拥有和平。无论他们住在哪里。)
[Aria] Let us talk about the UK defense minister. Why did he quit?
(让我们谈谈英国国防部长。他为什么辞职？)
[Andrew] He thinks the country is not safe enough. He wants more money for the military.
(他认为国家不够安全。他想要给军队更多的钱。)
[Aria] But the government has to spend money on other things too. Like schools and hospitals.
(但政府也必须在其他事情上花钱。比如学校和医院。)
[Andrew] It is a hard choice. What is more important? Safety or health?
(这是一个艰难的选择。什么更重要？安全还是健康？)
[Aria] Both are important. You cannot have one without the other.
(两者都很重要。没有一个就不能有另一个。)
[Andrew] That is a very good point. We need both to be happy.
(这是一个很好的观点。我们需要两者才能快乐。)
[Aria] Let us talk about Ukraine again. It is a long war.
(让我们再谈谈乌克兰。这是一场漫长的战争。)
[Andrew] Too long. People are tired of the fighting.
(太长了。人们厌倦了战斗。)
[Aria] We hope for a better future for them.
(我们希望他们有一个更好的未来。)
[Andrew] We all do. The world needs more peace and less war.
(我们都希望。世界需要更多的和平和更少的战争。)
[Aria] And finally, the story about the deportations. It is very complex.
(最后，关于驱逐出境的故事。它非常复杂。)
[Andrew] Yes, it is. People are looking for a better life.
(是的。人们在寻找更好的生活。)
[Aria] But countries have laws. It is hard to balance both.
(但国家有法律。平衡两者很难。)
[Andrew] It is one of the biggest challenges of our time.
(这是我们这个时代最大的挑战之一。)
[Aria] We have talked about many things today. I hope our listeners learned a lot.
(我们今天谈了很多事情。我希望我们的听众学到了很多。)
[Andrew] I think they did. It was a great conversation.
(我想他们学到了。这是一次很棒的谈话。)
[Aria] Thank you for being here, Andrew.
(谢谢你在这里，Andrew。)
[Andrew] Thank you, Aria. It was a pleasure.
(谢谢你，Aria。这是我的荣幸。)
[Aria] Let us do this again tomorrow.
(我们明天再做一次。)
[Andrew] I look forward to it.
(我很期待。)
[Aria] Have a great day, everyone.
(祝大家有美好的一天。)
[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)

item.title: 2026-06-13 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning and welcome to our news program. I am Aria.
(早上好，欢迎收听我们的新闻节目。我是 Aria。)
[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very busy day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有很多重要的新闻要带给大家。)
[Aria] We will start with the world of games. Bandai Namco has a big sale.
(我们先从游戏界开始。万代南梦宫正在进行一场大型促销活动。)
[Andrew] Yes, this is for the Nintendo Switch. Many games are at the lowest price ever.
(是的，这是针对任天堂 Switch 的。许多游戏的价格达到了历史最低点。)
[Aria] If you like games, this is a good time to look at the store.
(如果你喜欢游戏，现在是查看商店的好时机。)
[Andrew] It is not only about games. We have business news about Elon Musk and his company.
(不仅仅是游戏。我们还有关于埃隆·马斯克及其公司的商业新闻。)
[Aria] SpaceX is now a public company. It was a very big event in the market.
(SpaceX 现在是一家上市公司了。这是市场上的一件大事。)
[Andrew] Many people are talking about why he made this choice now.
(很多人都在讨论他为什么现在做出这个选择。)
[Aria] We will look at the history of the company and why it is so important.
(我们将回顾这家公司的历史，以及为什么它如此重要。)
[Andrew] Also, we have news about artificial intelligence. Anthropic has a problem.
(另外，我们还有关于人工智能的新闻。Anthropic 公司遇到了一些麻烦。)
[Aria] The government said they cannot give their models to people in other countries.
(政府表示，他们不能将模型提供给其他国家的人。)
[Andrew] This is a big change for the company and for the future of the technology.
(这对该公司以及这项技术的未来来说是一个巨大的改变。)
[Aria] And we have news about a big business deal. Paramount will buy Warner Bros.
(我们还有关于一笔大商业交易的新闻。派拉蒙将收购华纳兄弟。)
[Andrew] The government said this is okay. It is a very big change for the movie business.
(政府表示这没问题。这对电影行业来说是一个巨大的改变。)
[Aria] We will talk about why this is happening and what it means for you.
(我们将讨论为什么会发生这种情况，以及这对你意味着什么。)
[Andrew] Then we go to Switzerland. They are having a vote about the number of people in the country.
(然后我们去瑞士。他们正在就该国的人口数量进行投票。)
[Aria] They want to keep the number of people at ten million.
(他们希望将人口数量控制在 1000 万以内。)
[Andrew] It is a very interesting idea about the future of a country.
(这是一个关于国家未来的非常有趣的构想。)
[Aria] Finally, we have a story about the Pope. He had a problem with his plane.
(最后，我们有一个关于教皇的故事。他的飞机出了问题。)
[Andrew] The King of Spain helped him. It is a story of friendship and help.
(西班牙国王帮助了他。这是一个关于友谊和帮助的故事。)
[Aria] And we have news about a fight in the United Kingdom.
(我们还有关于英国一场冲突的新闻。)
[Andrew] Some people went into a factory and were put in prison.
(一些人闯入了一家工厂，被关进了监狱。)
[Aria] Let us start with the games. Andrew, tell us more about the Bandai Namco sale.
(让我们从游戏开始。Andrew，告诉我们更多关于万代南梦宫促销的信息。)
[Andrew] Bandai Namco is a very famous company. They make games that people love.
(万代南梦宫是一家非常有名的公司。他们制作人们喜爱的游戏。)
[Aria] Why is this sale so special?
(为什么这次促销如此特别？)
[Andrew] The prices are very low. Some games have never been this cheap.
(价格非常低。有些游戏从来没有这么便宜过。)
[Aria] This is good for people who want to play but do not have much money.
(这对那些想玩游戏但没有太多钱的人来说是件好事。)
[Andrew] It is also a good time to look at the history of these games.
(这也是回顾这些游戏历史的好时机。)
[Aria] Many of these games are very old but still very good.
(许多游戏虽然很老，但依然非常好玩。)
[Andrew] Yes, they have a long history of making people happy.
(是的，他们有让人们快乐的悠久历史。)
[Aria] Now, let us talk about SpaceX. Why did Elon Musk take the company to the public market?
(现在，让我们谈谈 SpaceX。为什么埃隆·马斯克要让公司上市？)
[Andrew] To be a public company means you can get money from many people.
(成为一家上市公司意味着你可以从许多人那里获得资金。)
[Aria] SpaceX needs a lot of money to build rockets.
(SpaceX 需要很多钱来建造火箭。)
[Andrew] Rockets are very expensive to make and to fly.
(火箭的制造和飞行非常昂贵。)
[Aria] By being public, they can get the money they need to go to space.
(通过上市，他们可以获得去太空所需的资金。)
[Andrew] It is a big step for the future of space travel.
(这对太空旅行的未来来说是重要的一步。)
[Aria] Many people think this will change how we see the stars.
(许多人认为这将改变我们看待星星的方式。)
[Andrew] It is a very bold move by a very famous person.
(这是一个非常有名的人做出的非常大胆的举动。)
[Aria] Now, let us move to the story about Anthropic.
(现在，让我们转向关于 Anthropic 的故事。)
[Andrew] The government is worried about the safety of the AI models.
(政府担心人工智能模型的安全性。)
[Aria] They think these models are too strong to be used by everyone.
(他们认为这些模型太强大了，不能让每个人都使用。)
[Andrew] So they said no to foreign access.
(所以他们拒绝了外国人的访问。)
[Aria] This is a hard situation for the company.
(这对公司来说是一个困难的局面。)
[Andrew] They want to share their work, but they must follow the law.
(他们想分享他们的工作，但他们必须遵守法律。)
[Aria] It shows that the world is still learning how to manage this new power.
(这表明世界仍在学习如何管理这种新的力量。)
[Andrew] AI is like a new tool. We must be careful with it.
(人工智能就像一种新工具。我们必须小心使用它。)
[Aria] Let us talk about the Paramount and Warner Bros deal.
(让我们谈谈派拉蒙和华纳兄弟的交易。)
[Andrew] This is a very big change for the media world.
(这对媒体界来说是一个巨大的改变。)
[Aria] When two big companies join, they become very strong.
(当两家大公司合并时，他们会变得非常强大。)
[Aria] The government looked at this for eight months.
(政府研究了这件事八个月。)
[Andrew] They wanted to be sure it would not hurt the market.
(他们想确保这不会伤害市场。)
[Aria] Now they say it is okay.
(现在他们说没问题。)
[Andrew] This will mean more movies and more shows for everyone.
(这意味着每个人都会有更多的电影和节目。)
[Aria] But some people are worried about the power of these big companies.
(但有些人担心这些大公司的力量。)
[Andrew] That is a fair point. We must watch what they do next.
(这是一个合理的观点。我们必须观察他们接下来会做什么。)
[Aria] Now, to Switzerland. Why do they want to limit the people?
(现在，去瑞士。他们为什么要限制人口？)
[Andrew] They think that if there are too many people, life will be hard.
(他们认为如果人太多，生活会变得困难。)
[Aria] They want to keep the land beautiful and the air clean.
(他们想保持土地的美丽和空气的清洁。)
[Andrew] It is a question of how much a country can hold.
(这是一个国家能容纳多少人的问题。)
[Aria] It is a very hard choice for the people there.
(这对那里的人民来说是一个非常艰难的选择。)
[Andrew] They will vote soon to decide the future.
(他们很快就会投票决定未来。)
[Aria] Let us talk about the Pope. It is a nice story.
(让我们谈谈教皇。这是一个不错的故事。)
[Andrew] Yes, he was in Spain and his plane had a problem.
(是的，他在西班牙，他的飞机出了问题。)
[Aria] He could not go home.
(他无法回家。)
[Andrew] The King of Spain gave him his own plane.
(西班牙国王给了他自己的飞机。)
[Aria] It shows that even the most important people need help sometimes.
(这表明即使是最重要的人有时也需要帮助。)
[Andrew] It is a story of kindness.
(这是一个关于善良的故事。)
[Aria] Finally, the news from the United Kingdom.
(最后，来自英国的新闻。)
[Andrew] Four people went to a factory. They did not like what the factory made.
(四个人去了一家工厂。他们不喜欢这家工厂生产的东西。)
[Aria] They were very violent.
(他们非常暴力。)
[Andrew] The law says you cannot do that.
(法律规定你不能那样做。)
[Aria] So they were put in prison.
(所以他们被关进了监狱。)
[Andrew] It is a reminder that we must follow the law even when we are angry.
(这提醒我们，即使在生气时也必须遵守法律。)
[Aria] That is all the news for today.
(这就是今天的所有新闻。)
[Andrew] Thank you for listening to our English learning news.
(感谢收听我们的英语学习新闻。)
[Aria] We hope you learned some new words today.
(我们希望你今天学到了一些新词。)
[Andrew] Keep practicing your English every day.
(每天坚持练习你的英语。)
[Aria] We will be back tomorrow with more news.
(我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。)
[Andrew] Have a great day and see you next time.
(祝你有美好的一天，下次见。)
[Aria] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)
[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)

item.title: 2026-06-13 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning everyone. Welcome to our daily news talk. I am Aria.
(大家早上好。欢迎收听我们的每日新闻谈话。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very full day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有很多重要的新闻要和大家分享。)

[Aria] We will start with the world of technology. Waze has a new way to help you when you are driving.
(我们先从科技界开始。Waze 有了一个新的方法，可以在你开车时为你提供帮助。)

[Andrew] Yes, Waze is now showing traffic lights on your map. This is a small change but it is very important for drivers.
(是的，Waze 现在在地图上显示交通灯了。这是一个小的改变，但对司机来说非常重要。)

[Aria] Many people have asked for this. It makes the driving experience much better.
(很多人都要求过这个功能。它让驾驶体验变得好多了。)

[Andrew] It is true. When you know where the lights are, you can make better choices on the road.
(确实如此。当你清楚交通灯在哪里时，你可以在路上做出更好的选择。)

[Aria] But there is more news in the tech world. Huawei has a new system called HarmonyOS.
(但在科技界还有更多新闻。华为有一个名为 HarmonyOS 的新系统。)

[Andrew] This system is very special. It can work on very little power.
(这个系统非常特别。它可以在极低的功耗下运行。)

[Aria] They say it can run for a year on one small battery. That is a great development.
(他们说它可以用一个小电池运行一年。这是一个了不起的进展。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the Trump phone. It was in the news because people took it apart to see how it was made.
(让我们谈谈特朗普手机。它上了新闻，因为人们把它拆开来看它是怎么制造的。)

[Andrew] That is right. They found that it was almost the same as a phone from another company.
(没错。他们发现它和另一家公司的手机几乎一模一样。)

[Aria] It shows that many parts in our phones come from the same places.
(这说明我们手机里的许多零件都来自同一个地方。)

[Aria] Now, let us move to business. Elon Musk is now the first person with a trillion dollars.
(现在，让我们转向商业。埃隆·马斯克现在是第一个拥有万亿美元资产的人。)

[Andrew] His company, SpaceX, had a very big day in the market.
(是的，他的公司 SpaceX 在市场上度过了非常重要的一天。)

[Aria] The value of the company went up by a large amount. This made him very rich.
(公司的价值大幅上升。这让他变得非常富有。)

[Andrew] It is a big change for the space industry. Many people are watching what he does next.
(这对航天工业来说是一个巨大的变化。许多人都在关注他下一步会做什么。)

[Aria] Also in business, the government said that Paramount and Warner Bros can join together.
(同样在商业方面，政府表示派拉蒙和华纳兄弟可以合并。)

[Andrew] This is a big merger. It will change how we watch movies and shows.
(这是一次重大的合并。它将改变我们观看电影和节目方式。)

[Aria] The government looked at the deal for eight months. They wanted to be sure it was fair.
(政府对这笔交易进行了八个月的审查。他们想确保它是公平的。)

[Andrew] Now that it is approved, the two companies can become one.
(既然已经批准，这两家公司就可以合二为一了。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the world news now. There was a game in the World Cup.
(现在让我们谈谈世界新闻。世界杯有一场比赛。)

[Andrew] Yes, Canada played against Bosnia and Herzegovina. It was a very hard game.
(是的，加拿大对阵波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那。那是一场非常艰难的比赛。)

[Aria] Cyle Larin was the hero of the day. He helped Canada get a point.
(凯尔·拉林是当天的英雄。他帮助加拿大拿到了一分。)

[Andrew] The fans were very happy. It was a great moment for the team.
(球迷们非常高兴。这对球队来说是一个伟大的时刻。)

[Aria] Also, we have news about Russia. Putin says they are making a new system for drones.
(此外，我们还有关于俄罗斯的新闻。普京说他们正在为无人机制造一个新系统。)

[Andrew] This system uses satellites. It will help them control drones from far away.
(这个系统使用卫星。这将帮助他们从很远的地方控制无人机。)

[Aria] This is a new way to fight in war. It is a very serious development.
(这是战争中一种新的战斗方式。这是一个非常严重的进展。)

[Andrew] We must watch this closely. Technology is changing how wars are fought.
(我们必须密切关注这一点。科技正在改变战争的打法。)

[Aria] Finally, there is a sad story from Canada. A police officer died.
(最后，来自加拿大有一个悲伤的故事。一名警察去世了。)

[Andrew] The police are looking into if this is linked to other attacks in the world.
(警方正在调查这是否与世界上的其他袭击有关。)

[Aria] It is a very difficult time for the people there. We hope for peace.
(这对那里的人们来说是一个非常困难的时期。我们祈求和平。)

[Andrew] We also have news about people being sent back to their home countries.
(我们还有关于人们被遣返回国的新闻。)

[Aria] Yes, some people were sent from the United States to the Central African Republic.
(是的，有些人被从美国送到了中非共和国。)

[Andrew] This is a very complex situation. Many lawyers are working on this.
(这是一个非常复杂的情况。许多律师正在处理这件事。)

[Aria] It is important to know the facts. We will keep you updated.
(了解事实很重要。我们会随时为您更新。)

[Andrew] That is all for our news today. It was a lot to cover.
(这就是我们今天的新闻。内容很多。)

[Aria] Thank you for listening to our podcast. We hope you learned some new words.
(感谢收听我们的播客。希望你们学到了一些新词。)

[Andrew] See you tomorrow for more news. Have a great day.
(明天见，会有更多新闻。祝你今天过得愉快。)

[Aria] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)

[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)

[Aria] Let us go back to the tech news. The Waze feature is very interesting.
(让我们回到科技新闻。Waze 的功能非常有趣。)

[Andrew] It is simple but it helps a lot. When you are in a city, you need to know where the lights are.
(它很简单，但很有帮助。当你在城市里时，你需要知道交通灯在哪里。)

[Aria] Many people use Waze every day. This update will make their life easier.
(很多人每天都用 Waze。这次更新会让他们的生活更轻松。)

[Andrew] And Huawei is doing something different. They are making systems that use very little power.
(而华为正在做一些不同的事情。他们正在制造功耗极低的系统。)

[Aria] That is good for the earth. If we use less power, we help the world.
(这对地球有好处。如果我们使用更少的电力，我们就是在帮助这个世界。)

[Andrew] The HarmonyOS system is growing. Many people are using it now.
(HarmonyOS 系统正在成长。现在很多人都在使用它。)

[Aria] It is a big challenge for other companies. They have to work hard to keep up.
(这对其他公司来说是一个巨大的挑战。他们必须努力工作才能跟上。)

[Andrew] The Trump phone story is also very interesting. It shows that even big names use parts from many places.
(特朗普手机的故事也非常有趣。它表明即使是大牌也会使用来自许多地方的零件。)

[Aria] It is a global world. Everything is connected.
(这是一个全球化的世界。一切都是相互联系的。)

[Andrew] Let us talk more about the SpaceX news. It is a huge deal.
(让我们多谈谈 SpaceX 的新闻。这是一笔大生意。)

[Aria] Elon Musk has changed how we think about space. Now he is changing the market too.
(埃隆·马斯克改变了我们对太空的看法。现在他也正在改变市场。)

[Andrew] People are excited about the future. They want to see what happens next.
(人们对未来感到兴奋。他们想看看接下来会发生什么。)

[Aria] The merger between Paramount and Warner Bros is also a big deal.
(派拉蒙和华纳兄弟之间的合并也是一件大事。)

[Andrew] It will create a very large company. They will have many movies and shows.
(它将创造一家非常大的公司。他们将拥有许多电影和节目。)

[Aria] This is good for the business. But we must see if it is good for the people.
(这对商业有好处。但我们必须看看这对人们是否有好处。)

[Andrew] Competition is important. We need many companies to have good choices.
(竞争很重要。我们需要许多公司来提供好的选择。)

[Aria] I agree. When there is competition, prices go down and quality goes up.
(我同意。当有竞争时，价格会下降，质量会上升。)

[Andrew] Let us talk about the sports news again. Canada did a good job.
(让我们再谈谈体育新闻。加拿大做得很好。)

[Aria] The World Cup is a time when the whole world comes together.
(世界杯是全世界团结在一起的时刻。)

[Andrew] It is nice to see people from different countries playing the same game.
(看到来自不同国家的人玩同一个游戏真是太好了。)

[Aria] And the drone news is a reminder that we live in a fast world.
(而无人机的新闻提醒我们，我们生活在一个快速发展的世界里。)

[Aria] We must use our knowledge for good things.
(我们必须把我们的知识用于好的事情。)

[Andrew] That is a very good point, Aria.
(这是一个很好的观点，Aria。)

[Aria] Thank you, Andrew. It is always good to talk with you.
(谢谢你，Andrew。和你谈话总是很好。)

[Andrew] Same here. I enjoy our time together.
(我也是。我很享受我们在一起的时间。)

[Aria] We have covered a lot today. Technology, business, and world events.
(我们今天涵盖了很多内容。科技、商业和世界大事。)

[Andrew] It is a lot to think about.
(有很多值得思考的事情。)

[Aria] Yes, it is. But that is why we are here. To help you understand.
(是的。但这就是我们在这里的原因。帮助你理解。)

[Andrew] We want to make the news clear and simple.
(我们想让新闻变得清晰简单。)

[Aria] And we want to help you learn English at the same time.
(我们也想同时帮助你学习英语。)

[Andrew] It is a great way to learn. By listening to the news.
(这是一种很好的学习方式。通过听新闻。)

[Aria] You get to hear how words are used in real life.
(你可以听到单词在现实生活中是如何使用的。)

[Andrew] And you get to hear about what is happening in the world.
(你还可以听到世界上正在发生什么。)

[Aria] It is a win for everyone.
(这对每个人来说都是双赢。)

[Andrew] I am happy to be part of this.
(我很高兴能参与其中。)

[Aria] Me too. Let us keep going.
(我也是。让我们继续。)

[Andrew] What else is on your mind today?
(你今天还在想什么？)

[Aria] I am thinking about the future of technology.
(我在想科技的未来。)

[Andrew] It is moving so fast.
(它发展得太快了。)

[Aria] Yes, it is. Every day there is something new.
(是的。每天都有新的东西。)

[Andrew] We have to be ready for it.
(我们必须为此做好准备。)

[Aria] That is true. We have to keep learning.
(那是真的。我们必须不断学习。)

[Andrew] And that is what we are doing here.
(这就是我们在这里所做的。)

[Aria] Learning together.
(一起学习。)

[Andrew] It is a good path.
(这是一条很好的道路。)

[Aria] I agree.
(我同意。)

[Aria] Let us take a short break.
(让我们休息一下。)

[Andrew] Good idea.
(好主意。)

[Aria] We will be back in a moment.
(我们一会儿回来。)

[Andrew] See you soon.
(一会儿见。)

[Aria] We are back. Let us talk about the importance of news.
(我们回来了。让我们谈谈新闻的重要性。)

[Andrew] News helps us know what is happening.
(新闻帮助我们了解正在发生的事情。)

[Aria] It helps us make decisions.
(它帮助我们做出决定。)

[Andrew] And it helps us understand other people.
(它帮助我们理解其他人。)

[Aria] That is why it is so important to have good news.
(这就是为什么拥有好的新闻如此重要。)

[Andrew] We try to bring you the best news.
(我们努力为您带来最好的新闻。)

[Aria] And we try to be fair.
(我们努力保持公正。)

[Andrew] That is our goal.
(这是我们的目标。)

[Aria] To be a guide for you.
(成为您的向导。)

[Andrew] I think we are doing a good job.
(我认为我们做得很好。)

[Aria] Thank you, Andrew.
(谢谢你，Andrew。)

[Andrew] You are welcome.
(不客气。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the weather.
(让我们谈谈天气。)

[Andrew] It is a nice day today.
(今天天气不错。)

[Aria] It is a good day for learning.
(这是学习的好日子。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is.
(是的。)

[Aria] I hope our listeners are having a good day too.
(我希望我们的听众也过得愉快。)

[Andrew] I am sure they are.
(我相信他们是。)

[Aria] We have a lot of listeners from all over the world.
(我们有来自世界各地的听众。)

[Andrew] That is amazing.
(太棒了。)

[Aria] It makes me happy to know that.
(知道这一点让我很高兴。)

[Andrew] We are connecting people.
(我们正在连接人们。)

[Aria] Through language and news.
(通过语言和新闻。)

[Andrew] It is a powerful thing.
(这是一件强大的事情。)

[Aria] Yes, it is.
(是的。)

[Andrew] Let us finish our talk for today.
(让我们结束今天的谈话。)

[Aria] We have done a lot.
(我们做了很多。)

[Andrew] We have covered the main stories.
(我们涵盖了主要故事。)

[Aria] And we have had a good talk.
(我们进行了一次很好的谈话。)

(我为明天做好了准备。)

[Aria] Me too.
(我也是。)

[Andrew] Goodbye to our listeners.
(向我们的听众说再见。)

[Aria] Goodbye.
(再见。)

[Andrew] See you next time.
(下次见。)

[Aria] Keep learning.
(继续学习。)

[Andrew] Keep listening.
(继续收听。)

[Aria] And keep growing.
(继续成长。)

[Andrew] Have a great day.
(祝你今天过得愉快。)

[Aria] You too.
(你也是。)

[Andrew] Bye.
(再见。)

[Aria] Bye.
(再见。)
